## Last commit: 2026-09-14 09:41:02 UTC by netops
version 21.4R3-S4.9;
system {
    host-name srx-edge-01;
    domain-name corp.example.net;
    root-authentication {
        encrypted-password "$6$REDACTED"; ## SECRET-DATA
    }
    login {
        message "Authorised access only. Activity is monitored.";
        idle-timeout 10;
        user netops {
            uid 2001;
            class super-user;
            authentication {
                encrypted-password "$6$REDACTED"; ## SECRET-DATA
            }
        }
        user auditor {
            uid 2002;
            class read-only;
            authentication {
                encrypted-password "$6$REDACTED"; ## SECRET-DATA
            }
        }
    }
    services {
        ssh {
            root-login deny;
            protocol-version v2;
            connection-limit 10;
        }
        web-management {
            https {
                system-generated-certificate;
                interface fxp0.0;
            }
        }
    }
    syslog {
        host 10.10.0.20 {
            any notice;
            authorization info;
        }
        host 10.10.0.21 {
            any warning;
        }
        file messages {
            any notice;
        }
    }
    ntp {
        server 10.10.0.10 prefer;
        server 10.10.0.11;
    }
    radius-server {
        10.10.0.30 {
            port 1812;
            secret "$9$REDACTED"; ## SECRET-DATA
        }
    }
    authentication-order [ radius password ];
}
interfaces {
    ge-0/0/0 {
        description "Uplink to core";
        unit 0 {
            family inet {
                address 10.10.10.2/30;
            }
        }
    }
    ge-0/0/1 {
        description "DMZ";
        unit 0 {
            family inet {
                address 192.0.2.1/24;
            }
        }
    }
    inactive: ge-0/0/7 {
        description "Decommissioned link";
        unit 0 {
            family inet {
                address 198.51.100.1/24;
            }
        }
    }
    fxp0 {
        description "Out of band management";
        unit 0 {
            family inet {
                address 10.10.0.5/24;
            }
        }
    }
}
snmp {
    community public {
        authorization read-only;
    }
    community Str0ngRW {
        authorization read-write;
    }
}
routing-options {
    static {
        route 0.0.0.0/0 next-hop 10.10.10.1;
        route 172.16.0.0/12 next-hop 192.0.2.254;
        route 10.99.0.0/16 discard;
    }
}
security {
    address-book {
        global {
            address dmz-web 192.0.2.10/32;
            address dmz-api 192.0.2.11/32;
            address-set dmz-services {
                address dmz-web;
                address dmz-api;
            }
        }
    }
    zones {
        security-zone trust {
            interfaces {
                ge-0/0/1.0;
            }
        }
        security-zone untrust {
            interfaces {
                ge-0/0/0.0;
            }
        }
    }
    policies {
        from-zone trust to-zone untrust {
            policy allow-web {
                match {
                    source-address any;
                    destination-address any;
                    application [ junos-http junos-https ];
                }
                then {
                    permit;
                    log session-close;
                }
            }
            policy deny-rest {
                match {
                    source-address any;
                    destination-address any;
                    application any;
                }
                then {
                    deny;
                }
            }
        }
        from-zone untrust to-zone trust {
            inactive: policy legacy-inbound {
                match {
                    source-address any;
                    destination-address dmz-web;
                    application junos-http;
                }
                then {
                    permit;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
